title: Two malicious versions of Microsoft's agent-framework PyPI package (1.26.1 and 1.26.2) stole cloud, CI and Azure managed-identity credentials on every Python start; if you installed either, rotate everything reachable from that environment.

Google's threat intelligence team says attackers have, for the first time, used LLM frameworks to fully automate vulnerability discovery and exploitation with no human in the loop, and expects fully agentic intrusions to follow.

Amazon's honeypots, posing as LLM APIs, captured ARTEX attack agents' own memory and showed criminals harvesting AI model keys from exposed LLM gateways and AI builders at industrial scale, then using the stolen keys to power more hunting.

SCKit, a worm-like toolkit found in the ScreenConnect MSP attacks, is built to jump from a customer endpoint to the technician who connects to it and on to other managed networks; 288 endpoints across 48 organizations were hit within 90 minutes.
A breach at inference provider Fireworks AI exposed Notion AI chat transcripts, a reminder that your AI subprocessors hold your users' prompts and need the same scrutiny as any data processor.

An attacker used two compromised Qubole IAM users to assume roles that customers had granted Qubole, then emptied Secrets Manager, SSM and S3 across dozens of AWS accounts. Third-party cross-account trust is the attack path, not AWS itself.

Claude Fable 5.2 takes #1 on independent leaderboards (Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 65 vs Gemini 4 Carbon 60), but cost per task rose ~31% on SemiAnalysis's GDPx despite cheaper tokens — effort level now matters as much as model choice.
